paths_reviewed.review_notes: The 114-insertion/817-deletion diff primarily extracts calendar/list/create presentation. The parent retains session permission, URL context, filters, selected appointment, and workflow ownership; the overview state/data lifecycle is delegated to the separately reviewed useAppointmentsOverview composable.

Reviewed request generation, disposal/permission checks, fail-closed forbidden handling, fast primary response publication, asynchronous optional service/name enrichment, cache writes, and invalidation behavior. The appointment read request is not aborted when superseded or invalidated, though stale results are ignored.

source_diff.assessment: The primary diff replaces large inline appointment list/calendar/create templates with extracted presentation components and wires props and semantic events. Permission codes, route/query state, filters, selection and service/mutation ownership stay in the parent.

test_execution.environment: Standalone SPA Vitest/JSDOM config. The parent suite mocks API and scheduling/appointment/owner/patient/service modules; the composable suite injects service fakes. No database global setup, provider, or live network call was observed.

architecture_observations: The page continues to own route/query context, permission codes, structural filters, local filters, selected appointment and mutation orchestration. The composable owns overview request/cache/loading state behind injected service and permission functions.

The page synchronously invalidates overview data, action state, selection and error when scheduling read permission is lost. The composable also rejects work when disposed or unauthorized, guards every response/cache update with a monotonically increasing request id, and routes forbidden responses through the parent permission reset.

The primary overview renders without waiting for service options or owner/patient name enrichment. Optional names load asynchronously and are cached; failures produce generic display fallbacks. Newer requests invalidate earlier overview and enrichment results.

Agenda query serialization persists structural filters but explicitly removes `search` and `clientSearch`; free-text values stay in the injected in-memory workspace context rather than URL/history. Tests assert private search terms are removed from the router query.

The focused tests cover stale request ordering, permission loss, disposal, read-only forbidden handling, selection reconciliation and late optional data. The extracted AgendaCalendarOrList, AppointmentCreateFlow and appointmentActionController are connected by parent events but are separate paths not reviewed in this round.

The loader has no AbortController; invalidation prevents stale UI/cache writes but does not cancel a superseded in-flight read request. No server authorization, tenant isolation, browser rendering, keyboard/screen-reader behavior, viewport or visual evidence was produced here.
